components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single decisive action in a focused panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 15px; color: #fff; background: #b4232a; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 0.78rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 18px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #971c22; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .62; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet cancel or alternate action beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 15px; color: #344054; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e7ec; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 0.78rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; border-color: #cfd4dc; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #f2f4f7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .62; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact Arabic-first field with clear focus and validation states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #344054; font: 700 .78rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-width: 0; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 12px; color: #1f2937; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d0d5dd; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #98a2b3; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #2684aa; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(7,104,159,.12); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #f04438; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(240,68,56,.10); } .ds-field input:disabled { color: #667085; background: #f2f4f7; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Two compact choices with an immediate, accessible selected state.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #f2f4f7; border-radius: 11px; font: 700 .8rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-segmented label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-segmented span { display: grid; min-height: 35px; place-items: center; color: #667085; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-segmented input:checked + span { color: #1f2937; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,.12); } .ds-segmented input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.24); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Background Card
components.description: A saved presentation background with a swatch, name, and compact actions.
components.html: خلفية الاجتماعصورة · Calibri
components.css: .ds-theme-card { overflow: hidden; color: #1f2937; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e4e7ec; border-radius: 14px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-theme-card:hover { border-color: #b4232a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-theme-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.18); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-theme-card-swatch { height: 72px; background: #15171d; } .ds-theme-card-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 5px 8px; padding: 12px; } .ds-theme-card strong { font-size: .91rem; } .ds-theme-card small { grid-column: 1; color: #667085; font-size: .72rem; } .ds-theme-card button { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; align-self: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; color: #475467; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #eaecf0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-card button:hover { color: #b4232a; background: #fff1f2; } .ds-theme-card button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.24); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Settings Navigation Row
components.description: A full-width settings destination with an icon, concise label, and stable affordance.
components.css: .ds-settings-row { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr 20px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #1f2937; background: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 .9rem/1.4 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: right; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-settings-row:hover { color: #b4232a; background: #fff1f2; } .ds-settings-row:active { background: #f2f4f7; } .ds-settings-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(7,104,159,.24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-settings-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #b4232a; background: #fff1f2; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-settings-arrow { color: #667085; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: Taraneem should feel like a purpose-built control surface beside a live church service: quiet enough to disappear, clear enough to operate under pressure, and dependable enough that every state is understood immediately. The visual system uses compact Shadcn-like controls, familiar icons with concise Arabic labels, and strong RTL structure. It is an application, not a dashboard. The full UI refresh should normalize the strongest patterns already present in the app: white working surfaces, cool neutral canvases, restrained red and blue accents, gently curved controls, and fast state feedback. Legacy styling may be migrated toward these tokens, but search normalization, keyboard shortcuts, mistake prevention, and second-screen behavior are never redesigned away. Custom presentation backgrounds may be expressive inside their preview and output. The editor around them stays neutral.
keyCharacteristics: Arabic-first RTL composition with predictable keyboard focus.
One primary red and one guidance blue over quiet neutral surfaces.
Icons support concise text; they never become visual decoration.
Motion is subtle, functional, and normally 150-250ms.
Flat working surfaces with elevation reserved for real hierarchy.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Red indicates decisive action or selection; Guidance Blue indicates focus or navigation. Never add a third decorative accent to an application surface.

rules.name: The Presentation Separation Rule
rules.body: User-selected background, text, and accent colors affect only the presentation preview and output. They never recolor editor labels, screen tags, controls, or validation states.

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Rule
rules.body: Saturated accent color occupies no more than ten percent of a normal working screen. Its rarity makes it useful.

rules.name: The UI/Output Rule
rules.body: Changing a custom background font changes the preview and second-screen output only. Application chrome remains stable.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Adjacent UI roles use a tight 1.125-1.2 scale. Large marketing-style headings are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls are flat at rest. Never combine a full border with a wide ambient shadow merely to make a surface feel premium.

rules.name: The One-Elevation-Cue Rule
rules.body: A component uses a border, tonal change, or shadow as its primary depth cue—not all three.

dos: Do build every screen as an Arabic-first RTL workflow with predictable keyboard order and visible Guidance Blue focus.
Do use Signal Red for decisive action or selection and Guidance Blue for focus or navigation.
Do keep common controls 40-42px high with 10px radii and compact spacing.
Do pair familiar icons with concise Arabic labels and accessible names.
Do preserve shortcuts, forgiving behavior, normalization, safe defaults, recovery paths, and second-screen behavior during the full UI update.
Do use subtle 150-250ms motion for state feedback and provide a reduced-motion equivalent.
Do let presentation themes be expressive inside preview/output while the editor stays neutral.
donts: Don't use generic AI-generated dashboard styling: repeated nested cards, excessive badges, decorative eyebrows, gradients, glass effects, oversized rounding, or wide soft shadows.
Don't make the interface colorful for decoration rather than communication.
Don't turn settings into a dense corporate dashboard that makes a simple workflow feel technical.
Don't use text-heavy controls when a familiar icon and concise label communicate the action faster.
Don't remove shortcuts, forgiving behavior, normalization, or safeguards to make a visual redesign cleaner.
Don't use decorative animation, slow transitions, or motion that delays live operation.
Don't recolor preview screen tags or application controls with a user's custom presentation colors.
Don't invent unfamiliar controls where a standard button, field, select, segmented control, or dialog action is clearer.
